label: Bible Study
prompt: And God said, Let there be _____: and there was light.
verse: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
note: God's first spoken words in Scripture — day one, and the lights come on.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my _____ shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
verse: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
note: Mountains may depart and hills be removed, but God's kindness won't budge an inch.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one _____ of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verse: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
note: The spies' souvenir: one cluster of grapes so big it took two men and a staff to carry it home.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the life of the flesh is in the _____: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verse: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
note: Leviticus in one verse — why the altar exists, and why Hebrews keeps quoting it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And I will put _____ between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verse: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
note: The protoevangelium — the first gospel promise, preached in Eden with one old word: enmity.
